unauthorized.description: The request has no valid bearer token: the one in `server.json`, or `CHANNELSTACK_TOKEN`.

invalid_argument.description: An argument is missing, or has the wrong type or shape.

not_found.description: The handle isn't there: it was removed, or belongs to another session.

session_not_found.description: The session was closed, or never existed.

internal.description: Something failed inside channelstack. The message says what.

unsupported_in_fake.description: The operation isn't built in the fake yet.

unsupported_in_live.description: The operation has no live counterpart, or not yet: delivery chaos, a person's Re-run. A test is skipped for it.

action_requires.description: A live action needs a piece live mode doesn't drive yet (the browser actor beyond typing and clicking, proxy mode), or one this run lacks (a real person to create a channel, team or page as, a saved browser session). A test is skipped for it.

live_misconfigured.description: Live mode is set up wrong: credentials set in part, a token of the wrong kind, a person without a token under `CHANNELSTACK_REALITY=live`. A test fails for it, so a broken nightly run goes red.

live_not_allowlisted.description: The live workspace, org or team isn't in its `CHANNELSTACK_LIVE_*` allowlist. Nothing was done there.

fake_actor_in_live_world.description: A fake person acts in a live workspace.

cross_workspace_credential.description: A person's token belongs to a different workspace than the app's.
